news.title: Zcash holders to vote on pulling 50,000 ZEC, worth $50 million, from grants treasury
news.summary: The proposal would remove more than half of Zcash Community Grants' ZEC holdings from circulation and redirect its future block rewards into a new development and legal-defense fund.

news.title: Bitcoin Core reveals bug that made thousands of nodes trust any stranger on Tor
news.summary: The flaw was fixed in October 2025 and kept quiet until Tuesday. It came out alongside a high-severity bug that could stop a miner from producing blocks until someone restarted it.

news.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
news.summary: Lending support among the ledger’s 35 validators has climbed from 19 to 22 since mid-October, and no public tracker shows which validators switched.
